title: CodeWalk Host Protocol v1 — provisional app-facing revision
description: Hand-authored canonical contract projection and separate CHP envelopes. Not a G1/G2/final G5 pass, Host implementation, or mutation authorization.

CanonicalDecimalSequence.description: Exact nonnegative BigInt decimal string; no uint64 ceiling. The not clause rejects final LF/CR despite dollar-anchor conventions.

CanonicalInstant.description: ISO time with zone, including signed expanded Dart DateTime years. Calendar semantics for expanded years remain canonical codec checks.
